definition_of_done: Bounded range reads and batches are covered by tests.
Explicit reread remains available and produces an auditable receipt.
ERP-MIG-F4-01-C021.goal: Provide bounded, repeat-aware reading of explicitly supplied document file paths/ranges for AI poise.
requirements: Accept explicit file paths/ranges and bounded batches; the caller supplies every path needed by the read operation.
Track path, content identity, range and context generation for repeat suppression.
After compaction/resume, do not claim unchanged memory merely because the file contents are unchanged.
Allow explicit reread of text when requested.

definition_of_done: Resume after context generation change restores required Task/route metadata deterministically.
Reader generation state causes needed text to be re-obtainable.
No second Task DB or copied lifecycle state is introduced.
ERP-MIG-F4-02-C023.goal: Restore the AI-poise Task/routing/reader context needed after compaction or resume from existing durable owners without copying Task DB state.
requirements: Reuse the existing Task, routing and reader owners rather than creating a parallel session state store.
Restore only facts needed to continue the current Poise workflow.
Any file rereads use explicit paths through C021.
Do not infer remembered document content solely from pre-compaction receipts.

definition_of_done: Telemetry failure cannot reject an otherwise valid work operation.
Failure and backlog diagnostics are covered by tests.
ERP-MIG-F4-03-C028-4.goal: Make AI-poise telemetry/accounting collection asynchronous and failure-isolated from the working path.
requirements: Work operations must not wait for or fail because of telemetry API/database/worker failure.
Queue/spool handling is bounded, replayable and idempotent.
Coverage gaps and delivery errors remain observable.
Do not weaken invariants of the primary Task database.

definition_of_done: Raw metric parameters and source timestamps survive asynchronous persistence.
Missing durations remain missing rather than fabricated.
ERP-MIG-F4-04-C028-5.goal: Persist available source API metrics and source timestamps through the asynchronous AI-poise accounting owner without inventing durations.
requirements: Store available raw parameters and source observation timestamp.
Preserve an API-provided duration as a source value but do not recompute missing intervals/durations during collection.
Do not silently replace the source observation time with a later persistence timestamp.
Aggregation/derived time math belongs to analytics, not ingestion.

definition_of_done: Supported hook effects can be traced to receipts/state owned by their feature owner.
Unsupported/missing native event delivery is diagnosed rather than inferred.
No general agent-compliance observer or second messaging source is introduced.
ERP-MIG-F4-05-C031.goal: Diagnose observable AI-poise hook/runtime effects using existing receipts and capability diagnostics after reader, telemetry and runner-hook work is available.
requirements: Do not migrate the ERP fixed observer run, prompt/schema or rule-compliance validator.
For a specific hook, diagnose its observable effect from native events/receipts and report unsupported or missing delivery explicitly.
Active diagnostics are explicit operations, not a standing gate; passive telemetry remains asynchronous.
Where code/files must be inspected, use explicit filesystem paths and keep ordinary Poise path resolution unchanged.
